jarvis church.bio: Jamaican-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Jarvis Church, born Gerald Eaton, is best known as the lead vocalist of Toronto band The Philosopher Kings and for his solo R&B and pop work.

joel plaskett.bio: Halifax-based singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Joel Plaskett is a Juno-winning Canadian artist whose work spans indie rock, power pop, folk, country and solo acoustic songwriting.

kinnie starr.bio: Calgary-born Canadian singer-songwriter Kinnie Starr blends indie rock with hip-hop, spoken word and electronic music in a multidisciplinary career spanning music, film and visual art.

kreesha turner.bio: Edmonton-born Canadian singer-songwriter Kreesha Turner blends R&B, pop, dance and reggae influences and is known for singles including Don't Call Me Baby and Bounce With Me.

len.bio: Toronto alternative group Len, founded by siblings Marc and Sharon Costanzo, mixed indie rock and hip-hop influences and became internationally known for the 1999 hit Steal My Sunshine.

les colocs.bio: Montréal band Les Colocs became one of Québec's defining 1990s rock groups by combining alternative rock, blues, swing, folk and global influences with socially observant French-language songwriting.

les cowboys fringants.bio: Repentigny, Québec band Les Cowboys Fringants is a major francophone folk-rock group known for energetic néo-trad music and socially and environmentally engaged songwriting.

les louanges.bio: Les Louanges is the project of Lévis-born Québec multi-instrumentalist Vincent Roberge, whose music blends alternative pop, contemporary R&B and electronic production.

limblifter.bio: Vancouver alternative-rock band Limblifter, founded by brothers Ryan and Kurt Dahle, emerged in the 1990s with melodic guitar-driven Canadian rock and later continued through several lineups.

lou phelps.bio: Saint-Hubert, Québec rapper and producer Lou Phelps, born Louis-Philippe Celestin, makes groove-heavy hip-hop and is also known for collaborating with his brother Kaytranada in The Celestics.

loud.bio: Montréal rapper Loud, born Simon Cliche Trudeau, is a leading Québec hip-hop artist whose solo work combines polished rap songwriting with a distinctly francophone voice.

love inc..bio: Toronto dance group Love Inc., formed by producers Chris Sheppard and Brad Daymond with vocalist Simone Denny, helped define late-1990s Canadian Eurodance with hits including Broken Bones and You're a Superstar.

luce dufault.bio: Orléans, Ontario-born singer Luce Dufault is a prominent francophone Canadian vocalist whose career spans pop recordings, major Québec stage productions and long-running live performance.
